note: Tick checkbox 'Enable auto-unbox' (khong Save) de lo o 'Auto-unbox after'/'Trigger before'. Click thuc hien duoc, nhung ngay sau do browser_snapshot va browser_network_requests bi permission classifier tu choi ('[Auto-Mode Bypass]' / 'server-side auto mode classifier judged this action dangerous'). Khong thu lai, khong lach. Vi vay KHONG co network capture cho cua so action nay va cho click untick (cleanup) ngay sau do.
